source_text:
τὸν ἀπὸ τοῦ ἁγίου ἄρτον, καὶ διψήσας ποτισθῇ τῷ ἀπὸ τῆς ἁγίας πηγῆς ὕδατι ζῶντι·
διὸ καλόν ἐστιν ἔργον σωρεῦσαι ἄνθρακας ὅ ἐστι λόγους ἐκλεκτοὺς ἐπὶ τὴν τοῦ
ἐχθροῦ κεφαλήν· ὃν ὁ κύριο Ἰη οῦ ἀναλοῖ τῷ πνεύματι τοῦ τόματο αὐτοῦ, τοῦτο
γάρ ἐστι τὸ σωτήριον πῦρ, περὶ οὗ εἶπεν πῦρ ἦλθον βαλεῖν ἐπὶ τὴν γῆν, ἀντὶ τοῦ ἀναλῶσαι καὶ ἐξαφανίσαι πάντα τὰ σωματικὰ καὶ ὑλικά. πολλῶν δὲ ἀνθράκων χρεία ἵνα
ἡ τοῦ ἐχθροῦ κεφαλὴ ἐξαναλωθῇ· οἵτινές εἰσιν οἱ ἀληθεῖς λόγοι οἱ ἐξαφανίζοντες τὸ
ψεῦδος· ὅταν οὖν ἀναλωθῇ ἢ χειρωθῇ ἡ κεφαλὴ ὑπὸ τῶν σωρευομένων ἀνθράκων,
ἐκ τοῦ τρέφεσθαι πεινῶντα τὸν ἐχθρὸν γίνεται ὁ ποτὲ ἐχθρὸς φίλος καὶ κέχρηται
κεφαλῇ τῷ Χριστῷ.
pass_a_gloss: —the bread from the holy one, and having thirsted is given to drink the living water from the holy spring; therefore it is a fine work to heap coals—that is, chosen words—upon the enemy's head; whom the Lord Jesus consumes with the spirit of his mouth, for this is the saving fire, about which he said 'I came to cast fire upon the earth,' instead of consuming and making vanish all bodily and material things. And there is need of many coals so that the enemy's head may be thoroughly consumed; which are the true words that make falsehood vanish. When then the head is consumed or mastered by the heaped coals, from the feeding of the hungering enemy the one who was once an enemy becomes a friend and uses Christ as head.
pass_b_english: —the bread from what is holy, and when thirsty is given living water from the holy spring. So it is a fine work to heap coals—that is, chosen words—on the enemy's head. The Lord Jesus consumes that head [[with the spirit of his mouth >> Bible:2 Thessalonians 2:8]]; this is the saving fire of which he said, [[I came to cast fire on the earth >> Bible:Luke 12:49]]—meaning the consuming and vanishing of all that is bodily and material.

Many coals are needed so the enemy's head may be thoroughly burned away; they are the true words that make falsehood vanish. When that head is consumed or mastered by the heaped coals, feeding the hungry enemy turns the former enemy into a friend who now has Christ as head.

choices.choice: Glossed coals as chosen/true words that destroy falsehood, following Origen.
Closed the arc: former enemy now uses Christ as head.
